title: fix(plugin-grid,plugin-list,components,types): the grid's inline-edit saves send each row's If-Match, and Save All reports per row (objectui#12292)
body:
Fixes #12292
Clause-②: yes — `DataTableSchema.onBatchSave` in `@object-ui/types` (published) widens its declared return: a handler may now resolve with `{ failed: [{ rowIndex, error }] }`. Additive: a handler that resolves with nothing, or rejects, is read exactly as before, so no existing handler changes. It is needed because the ruling's batch clause (a refused row fails on its own, the other rows are reported as they are) cannot be met while the table reads every batch as all-or-nothing. No prop, spec key, export or i18n key is added.

Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 1 (claim comment 6137901330). Implementing session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_01CsyMRsFJBKNEMa4oPY1b5z`.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/plugin-grid` `ObjectGrid`**
  - `defaultRowSave` and `defaultBatchSave` send each row's `updated_at` as `ifMatch`, read as the record surfaces read it (`occVersionOf` in `plugin-form`, the save in `plugin-detail`'s `InlineEditSaveBar`). A row with no token stays unguarded, as before.
  - After a landed write, the row's next save sends the token of the record the server answered with: the `versionToSend` rule `plugin-form` applies to a form that stays open, applied per record. A newer read of the row wins over it.
  - A `409` opens `ConcurrentUpdateDialog` from `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, the dialog `InlineEditSaveBar` opens. `plugin-grid` already depends on `plugin-detail`, so there is no new dependency edge. Reload latest writes nothing and declares the record changed on the invalidation bus, so whoever holds the rows re-reads them. Overwrite anyway re-sends the same changes keyed to the `409`'s `currentVersion`. Cancel rejects with the `409`, so the table keeps the edit and flags the row. There is no grid-only dialog, and nothing is retried without the user's choice.
  - "Save All" attempts every row (`Promise.allSettled`), asks about conflicts one row at a time, and hands back the rows that did not persist as `{ failed }`. Nothing the server accepted is rolled back.
  - The grid's own query asks for `updated_at` when the grid is authored `editable`.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-list` `ListView`**: its query asks for `updated_at` while the grid it hands rows to is in inline-edit mode, the same expression as that grid's `editable`.
- **`@object-ui/components` `data-table`**: `saveBatch` reads a `{ failed }` outcome per row. It keeps and flags exactly those rows and clears the rest. A failure naming a row the batch did not hand over falls back to all-or-nothing, so an unsaved edit is never cleared.
- **`@object-ui/types`**: the `onBatchSave` declaration and its doc.
- **Docs**: `content/docs/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx`, `content/docs/components/complex/data-table.mdx`, `packages/plugin-grid/README.md`.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-form` write census** (`affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`, a test file; nothing of `plugin-form` ships from it): the grid's two `update` sites move from `ObjectGrid > defaultRowSave` and `ObjectGrid > defaultBatchSave` to `ObjectGrid > writeRowGuarded` and `ObjectGrid > resolveRowConflict`, still `mapped(['listInlineEdit'], OBJECT_GRID)` (round 3, `b87fdb4`; this line added by the seat, as the dev's report `6140159070` names).
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/12292-grid-save-if-match.md`: `minor` for `@object-ui/types` and `@object-ui/components`, `patch` for `@object-ui/plugin-grid` and `@object-ui/plugin-list` (levels corrected at `0af4fcc` after the seat's REWORK; this line updated by the seat, as the dev's report `6139070698` names).

## Measured before writing (the dispatch's mechanism assumptions)

1. **What the caller does with a rejection.** `data-table`'s `saveRow` keeps and flags its one row. `saveBatch` was all-or-nothing: on a rejection it kept every pending row, flagged every row and showed one "Save failed" line, with no toast. Under `Promise.all`, one refused row therefore left the rows that had already landed pending and flagged, and a retry would send them again. So the batch clause needs the table to read a per-row outcome. That is the published-type change above.
2. **The shared conflict path.** `plugin-detail` exports `ConcurrentUpdateDialog` and `isConcurrentUpdateError`, and `plugin-grid` already depends on it. `plugin-form`'s `useOccSave` is module-private to `plugin-form`, which `plugin-grid` does not depend on. The grid builds the dialog's payload the way `InlineEditSaveBar`'s `buildConflict` does (one field shows its own before and after; several show the record summary under the existing `detail.concurrentUpdateRecordLabel` key) rather than exporting that callback, so `plugin-detail` is read, not edited.
3. **What a stale `If-Match` answers through the console's adapter.** Read from the installed 17.7.0 packages. `@objectstack/types` maps a `ConcurrentUpdateError` to `409` with `{ error, code: 'CONCURRENT_UPDATE', currentVersion, currentRecord, object }`. `@objectstack/client` throws an Error carrying `code`, `httpStatus` and `details` set to that body. `data-objectstack`'s `normaliseClientError` re-wraps it as `ConcurrentUpdateError` with `currentVersion` and `currentRecord`. The pins drive the real adapter and client over a stubbed `fetch` that answers exactly that envelope. NOT MEASURED: a round trip against a live server, because no objectstack server runs in this container.
4. **Falsified: reading the row's `updated_at` alone sends nothing in the console.** The console list's rows come from `ListView`'s query, and its `$select` is the columns plus `id`, expand and predicate operands. No column of the showcase task grid view shows `updated_at`, and the server projects exactly the keys selected. The grid's own query has the same shape. So both projection sites now carry the token. Without that, the save code would be correct and the console would still send no `If-Match`.

## Pins (all on the real `ObjectGrid` and `data-table`)

`packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/inlineEditConcurrency-12292.test.tsx`. Writes go through the real `ObjectStackAdapter` and `@objectstack/client`; reads honour `$select` the way the server does, so a projection that drops the token fails these pins too.
- A stale row save sends `If-Match` and surfaces the `409` on the conflict dialog. Cancel writes nothing, keeps the edit and flags the row.
- Overwrite anyway re-sends keyed to the `409`'s `currentVersion`. Reload latest writes nothing and re-reads.
- A fresh save succeeds, and the next save of the same row (re-read not landed) sends the token the server answered with.
- A batch with one stale row reports that row: "1 row modified", "Save All (1)", the stale row keeps its edit, the saved row is not rolled back, and there are exactly two `PATCH`es (no retry).
- The grid's query asks for `updated_at` though no column shows it.

`packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.concurrencyTokenProjection-12292.test.tsx`: the list asks for `updated_at` in inline-edit mode, and not outside it (control).

`packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table-batch-per-row-12292.test.tsx`: a `{ failed }` outcome keeps only the named row; an empty one clears all; an unplaceable one keeps all.

Two existing pins (`inlineEditExitMode.test.tsx`, `inlineEditPersistence.test.tsx`) asserted the save's three-argument call. They now state the fourth argument, `undefined`, because their fixtures carry no `updated_at`.

## Ablation (one-shot, each leg restored from `HEAD` and proven by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

Run through `ablation-replace.mjs`; tests resolve `@object-ui/*` to `src` through the root vitest alias table, so no `dist` rebuild was involved.
- Drop `ifMatch` from the default saves (at `989c000`): 5 of 6 grid pins red (no dialog appears; the next-save pin reads `ifMatch: undefined`). The projection pin stays green, as expected.
- Drop the token from the grid's projection (at `aee4247`): 6 of 6 grid pins red.
- Drop it from `ListView`'s projection (at `aee4247`): the inline-edit pin red, the control green.
- Make `data-table` ignore the per-row outcome (at `aee4247`): the per-row pin red, the other two green.

## Gates (at `d061c98` unless stated)

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/ packages/types/`: 753 files passed, 1 skipped; 14089 tests passed, 24 skipped.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/ packages/plugin-list/` plus five outside suites that render the grid in inline-edit mode (`plugin-view` `ObjectView.namedViewInlineEdit-10885`, `ObjectView.tableEditable-10976`, `ObjectView.namedViewEditInlineFold-5144`; `app-shell` `ObjectView.inlineEditSessionOnly-5144`, `InterfaceListPage.editInlineFold-5144`): at `5a050db`, 339 files passed and 2 failed, both on the call-shape assertion above. `d061c98` changes only those two test files, and they plus the new grid pins pass there (3 files, 13 tests).
- `type-check` of `@object-ui/types`, `@object-ui/components`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`: exit 0 each, script name echoed (`plugin-grid` re-run at `5a050db`).
- ESLint on the nine touched TypeScript files, read from `--format json`: 0 errors. The config sets no type-aware parser options and no rule in `eslint-rules/` reads another file, so this diff cannot move the verdict of an untouched file.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-json`: all exit 0.
- Not run, and why: `check:phantom-deps` / `check:unused-deps` (no package gains a dependency); `check:eager-closure` (no module edge is added: `ObjectGrid` already imports the `plugin-detail` entry); `check:i18n-*` beyond `i18n-keys` (no string added).

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** The claim expected `ObjectGrid.tsx` alone. Measurement put two producers elsewhere: the token's projection in `plugin-list`'s `ListView`, and the batch outcome's reader in `components`' `data-table` with its declaration in `types`. The dispatch allowed a fix at the producer; the widening is the only published change.
- **Cancel leaves the row flagged.** On the record page, Cancel returns to the draft with no error line. In the grid the save rejects, so the row is tinted and the toolbar shows "Save failed: Record was modified by another user". That is the table's existing contract for a save that did not land, and it says which row did not save.
- **Pending edits follow the row index, not the record.** This is older than this change, and a failing probe shows it. With rows sorted most recently modified first, two rows edited and one of them saved by its row button, the re-read puts the saved row first. The other row's pending value is then shown on the saved row, and "Save All" writes it to the saved record. The token does not catch this, because the wrong row's token is current. Reported to the seat, not fixed here.
- `ApiDataSource` (`@object-ui/core`) throws a plain Error on any non-2xx, so a `409` through it is not recognised as a conflict on any surface. The console uses `data-objectstack`. Noted only.
